title: Stop resolving items with every field where only stored columns are read
body:
Needs #17881

We don't need all the data we are fetching by default to decide if something is visible or not.

**Changes**
Limit data fetched to stored colums when possible.

**Code assistance**
None

**Issues**
Fixes #17871
